concept: A score from one to five stars, the chosen ones in the loud solid and the rest an outline, read by count and shape.

default_to_avoid.pattern: gold filled stars on grey (the common star rating)
default_to_avoid.why_not: gold is a hue the system does not own, and a grey empty star can vanish on glass

derivation.consequence: the scene supplies the hue; the system owns no hue of its own, only white at opacities and one ink, and colour appears only where it states a status or marks a diagram
derivation.form: chosen stars are the loud solid, white in dark and ink in light, never gold

derivation.consequence: selected and pressed states change shape or add a mark (a check, a ring), never only colour
derivation.form: empty stars stay an outline at the 3:1 edge, so the count reads without colour

derivation.consequence: keyboard reaches everything a pointer can, with a visible focus ring on any backdrop
derivation.form: each star is a radio in a 44px press area; arrow keys change the score

options: A loud solid stars and outlines
C a number out of five
variants.picked: A loud solid stars and outlines
variants.reason: A keeps the system’s one solid (P1, P5). B brings a hue. C loses the glance the stars give.

root.why: the stars in a row with a small gap

item.why: each star is a radio with a 44px press area

star.why: the star outline at the edge opacity, the same in every theme and on every scene

on.why: a chosen star filled with the loud solid

readOnly.why: a shown score that is read as a whole, such as 4 out of 5

focus-visible.why: the focus ring inside the focused star’s press area

data-state=checked.why: the checked star is filled, the same in every theme and on every scene

data-on.why: every star up to the score is filled

@media forced-colors: active.why: forced colours fill chosen stars with the system text colour

data-disabled.why: an off control dims and refuses presses, so it reads as there but not available

fill.why: a star fills at press pace, the same in every theme and on every scene
